content: MLE training: An Adam optimizer is used with the learning rate of 0.0001 to optimize $L_{\text{MLE}}$. The batch size is set as 128 and a one-layer, bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (bi-LSTM) model with 512 hidden sizes and a 350 embedding size is utilized. Gradients with the l2 norm larger than 2.0 are clipped. We stop training when the ROUGE-L f-score stops increasing.
